what: Over the card strip, when the cursor enters the 20% at the left or right screen edge (the side that can be paged), an 83px disc (92% dark) turns on there, growing from .6× over .4s, and trails the cursor by .14 of the remaining distance each frame. Two rings around the disc draw over 1s and 1.1s (.09 and .18s late), the disc makes one turn in 16 seconds, and the center arrow points that way. At the end position the strip gets is-edge, which stops card hover, and pressing pages that way (pressing the prev/next button or fx:prev · fx:next). Back at center, the disc turns off and card links are clickable as usual. .82× while pressed

options.zone: Flip zone — ratio at both ends of the screen width, default .2
options.follow: Follow share (fraction of remaining distance per frame), default .14
options.hide: (If present) CSS that switches the disc off and does not advance when inside — for items pressed separately, like page indicator dots
options.[data-fx-part=area]: (if present) inner band where the disc lights up — otherwise the whole element. When it can be scrolled to that side, is-edge is added to this element
options.[data-fx-part=prev] · [data-fx-part=next: (if present) the button to press instead on click. If it is disabled, aria-disabled or swiper-button-disabled, that arrow is not shown as active
options.[data-fx-part=cursor]: (if present) the disc — if absent, builds a disc containing two rings and an arrow
options.--fx-size · --fx-disc · --fx-ring: Disc size, panel color, ring and arrow color (css), default 83px · --kf-contrast-bg · --kf-contrast-ink
options.--fx-spin · --fx-ease: Disc one-turn length and turn-on curve (css), default 16s · cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)

note: half-arrow-cursor decides direction by which half of the panel you are on and attaches right at the cursor position. Here only the two window edges are advance zones and the middle keeps links working. The original panel is position: fixed, so it is not used if the panel or an ancestor has a transform. Swiper only needs to receive fx:prev and fx:next and call slidePrev and slideNext. Off on touch devices

from.where: shared.js news band · partner band · people marquee (original edgePaging: lerp .14 · stop .05, end 20%, disc 83px · ring .9/1/1.1s, is-pressed .82)
